chunks: What is that in your right hand, O Moses?
ai.seo_question: What did Allah ask Prophet Moses about in his right hand?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Taa-Haa, Allah asks Prophet Moses (AS) about the object in his right hand, identified by Shia exegetes as his staff, which symbolizes his humble means before divine empowerment. This inquiry serves as a pedagogical moment, prompting Moses to acknowledge the tool Allah provided, thereby illustrating the principle that miracles stem from divine will rather than inherent power. The verse underscores the transition from human limitation to divine authority, a key theme in the narrative of Musa's mission.
